title: A Train Ride to the Mountains
text:
Last winter, Tom took a train to the mountains. The journey was long, but the views from the window were beautiful. He sat next to an old woman who had a big basket of apples. She shared one with him.

In the mountains, Tom stayed in a wooden cabin. Every morning he walked in the snow. He took many photos and wrote a diary about his trip. He wants to return next winter.

questions.text: How did Tom travel to the mountains?
What did the old woman have?
How did Tom probably feel about the trip?
options: He was very tired and bored
He was afraid of the snow

questions.text: Why did Tom probably want to return next winter?
options: He liked the place a lot
He did not like the cabin

vocabulary.definition: a trip from one place to another
a small simple house, often made of wood
a book where a person writes about their days

paragraph_translations: Минулої зими Том поїхав потягом у гори. Дорога була довгою, але краєвиди з вікна були чудові. Він сидів поруч зі старою жінкою, яка мала великий кошик із яблуками. Вона поділилася з ним одним яблуком.
У горах Том жив у дерев'яній хатинці. Щоранку він гуляв по снігу. Він робив багато фотографій і вів щоденник про свою подорож. Він хоче повернутися наступної зими.
